metadata.description: Golden evaluation dataset for RAG pipeline. Answerable questions reference exact facts from the 5-document TechNova corpus. Unanswerable questions test abstention behavior.

questions.question: How many annual paid leave days does a full-time employee receive at TechNova?
questions.answer: Full-time employees receive 21 paid leave days per year.

questions.question: What percentage of health insurance premium does TechNova cover for employees?
questions.answer: TechNova covers 80% of the health insurance premium. Dependent coverage is available at a 40% subsidy.

questions.question: What is the company's contribution to the Provident Fund as a percentage of gross salary?
questions.answer: The company contributes 10% of gross salary to the Provident Fund. The mandatory employee contribution is 8%.

questions.question: When is the annual bonus paid and what is the minimum performance rating required to receive it?
questions.answer: The annual bonus (up to 15% of base salary) is paid in March and requires a performance rating of 3.5 out of 5 or higher.

questions.question: How long is fully paid maternity leave at TechNova?
questions.answer: Maternity leave is 16 weeks, fully paid.

questions.question: What performance rating triggers a Performance Improvement Plan, and how many consecutive reviews must result in that rating?
questions.answer: Employees rated below 2.5 out of 5 for two consecutive reviews are placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP).

questions.question: What is the gift value threshold above which an employee must report it to the Ethics Committee?
questions.answer: Gifts exceeding PKR 5,000 in value must be reported to the Ethics Committee.

questions.question: Are probationary employees allowed to work from home at TechNova?
questions.answer: No. Probationary employees (first 6 months) must work from the office 5 days per week. Remote work is only available to employees with more than 6 months of tenure.

questions.question: Which day of the week is mandatory office attendance for all TechNova staff?
questions.answer: Fridays are mandatory office days for all staff.

questions.question: What is the annual equipment stipend for home internet reimbursement?
questions.answer: The annual stipend for home internet is PKR 36,000, reimbursed monthly at PKR 3,000 per month.

questions.question: What type of Wi-Fi encryption is prohibited for remote workers at TechNova?
questions.answer: WEP and WPA networks are strictly prohibited. Home networks must use WPA3 encryption.

questions.question: What are the core collaboration hours for remote employees?
questions.answer: Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 13:00 PKT daily. Remote employees must also be reachable on Slack between 09:00 and 17:00 PKT.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length required by TechNova's security policy?
questions.answer: The minimum password length is 14 characters. Passwords must also contain uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and at least 2 special characters.

questions.question: How often do employee passwords expire according to the security policy?
questions.answer: Passwords expire every 90 days, and the last 12 passwords cannot be reused.

questions.question: What data classification level applies to client data, and what encryption standard is required for it?
questions.answer: Client data is classified as Level 3 (Confidential). Level 3 and Level 4 data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256.

questions.question: Within how many hours must a security incident be reported, and to what email address?
questions.answer: Security incidents must be reported to security@technova.com within 1 hour of detection.

questions.question: Within how many hours must a terminated employee's account be disabled?
questions.answer: Terminated employee accounts must be disabled within 2 hours of HR notification.

questions.question: How many business days in advance must business travel be approved?
questions.answer: All business travel must be approved at least 5 business days in advance by the direct manager and Finance.

questions.question: What is the daily per diem allowance for meals when traveling to Lahore?
questions.answer: The daily meal allowance for travel to Lahore is PKR 2,500, with an additional PKR 500 for incidentals, totalling PKR 3,000 per diem.

questions.question: Is alcohol reimbursable as a travel expense at TechNova?
questions.answer: No. Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances.

questions.question: What is the reimbursement rate for using a personal vehicle for business travel?
questions.answer: Personal vehicle use is reimbursed at PKR 18 per kilometer.

questions.question: How many annual leave days does a part-time employee receive?
questions.answer: Part-time employees receive 10 paid leave days per year.
questions.note: paraphrase of Q01 from part-time angle

questions.question: What standard software is provided to new TechNova employees on Day 1, and what email format is used?
questions.answer: Standard software includes Slack, Zoom, MS Office 365, Jira, Confluence, and GitHub. The email format is firstname.lastname@technova.com.

questions.question: Within how many days of joining must a new employee enroll in health insurance?
questions.answer: Health insurance enrollment must be completed within the first 30 days. After that, employees must wait for the annual open enrollment period.

questions.question: Who should a new employee contact if they have an IT issue, and what is the extension number?
questions.answer: New employees should contact the IT Helpdesk at it-support@technova.com or call extension 2001.

questions.question: What is the gym membership subsidy amount and from which month does it become available?
questions.answer: A gym membership subsidy of PKR 3,000 per month is available from Month 3 of employment.

questions.question: How much notice is required before taking unpaid leave?
questions.answer: Employees must provide 30 days written notice to take unpaid leave. Unpaid leave can extend up to 6 months.

questions.question: What is the maximum hotel rate allowed per night for international travel?
questions.answer: The maximum hotel rate for international travel is USD 200 per night. For domestic travel it is PKR 15,000 per night.

questions.question: What is TechNova's policy on employee stock options or equity grants?
questions.reason: No document in the corpus mentions stock options, equity, or ESOPs.

questions.question: What is the company's official stance on office pets or pet-friendly workplaces?
questions.reason: No document mentions pets or pet policies.

questions.question: Does TechNova offer a sabbatical leave program for long-term employees?
questions.reason: Sabbatical leave is not mentioned in any document. Only annual, sick, maternity, paternity, and unpaid leave are covered.

questions.question: What is TechNova's parental leave policy for adoptive parents?
questions.reason: Only biological maternity (16 weeks) and paternity (2 weeks) leave are mentioned. Adoptive parent leave is not addressed.

questions.question: What is the company cafeteria menu and are meal subsidies provided?
questions.reason: No document mentions a cafeteria, meal subsidies, or food-related office benefits.

questions.question: How does TechNova handle disputes between employees through mediation or arbitration?
questions.reason: The documents mention a disciplinary process but do not describe a formal mediation or arbitration procedure.

questions.question: What is TechNova's policy on using personal AI tools like ChatGPT or Copilot for work tasks?
questions.reason: No document addresses the use of personal AI tools or generative AI at work.

questions.question: What is the company's flexi-time or compressed workweek policy?
questions.reason: No document mentions flexi-time arrangements or compressed workweeks. Only remote work eligibility and core hours are described.
